_doc: Curated membership of organizations and blocs relevant to Ethiopia's foreign relations, by ISO3 (matching data/geo/world.geojson). Ethiopia's own membership is computed from whether ETH is in each list. This is a selected set, not every organization. Membership is as of 2025; review with the monthly checklist. Sources are official bloc pages.

blocs.name: IGAD
blocs.note: Intergovernmental Authority on Development (Horn of Africa).

blocs.name: COMESA
blocs.note: Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa.

blocs.name: East African Community
blocs.note: Regional economic community; Ethiopia is not a member.

blocs.name: BRICS+
blocs.note: Expanded BRICS grouping; Ethiopia joined in January 2024.

blocs.name: Arab League
blocs.note: League of Arab States; Ethiopia is not a member.

blocs.name: European Union
blocs.note: Ethiopia is not a member; the EU is a major donor and trade partner.

blocs.name: Nile Basin Initiative
blocs.note: Riparian states of the Nile; central to the GERD question.

blocs.name: OPEC
blocs.note: Oil exporters; Ethiopia is not a member.

blocs.name: Commonwealth
blocs.note: Commonwealth of Nations; Ethiopia is not a member.

blocs.name: G20
blocs.note: Major economies; Ethiopia participates through the African Union (a G20 member since 2023) but is not an individual member.
